title: Microservices
body:
An architecture that splits a system into small independently deployable services that talk
over the network, instead of one deployable unit. It is [[Coupling and Cohesion]] taken to
the deployment level: each service owns one job and can be changed and released without
touching the others.

The trade is not free. You remove internal complexity and get network complexity back:
partial failure, latency, versioned interfaces between services, and distributed data that
no single transaction covers. A system too small to have a coupling problem gets none of the
benefit and all of the cost.

Mostly 3rd-year material; see [[WEB DEVELOPMENT FOR CS]] and [[REST APIs]] for it applied to
a real stack.
